This role is a key element of our newly established Fincrime Intelligence and Reporting function. You'll be responsible for ensuring we put our genuine members first, through reporting potentially suspicious activity to authorities and taking measures to disrupt criminals. You'll have opportunities to be involved in wider Financial Crime projects which will help reduce risk to Tide and let our members get back to doing what they love.

As an Investigative Reporting Analyst you'll be:

* Achieve and maintain formal accreditation to carry out specific responsibilities on behalf of Tide's Nominated Officer, including collating and evaluating internal reports for inclusion within reports to Law Enforcement and ensuring the accuracy and quality of external reports
* Collating information and writing comprehensive reports relating to all types of financial crime for inclusion within notifications to Law Enforcement Agencies, including SAR submissions
* Supporting in complex, proactive investigations by ensuring we report the right information at the right time to external partners
* Providing assurance by reviewing the outcomes and decisions of cases, determining whether the correct case outcome was achieved and correctly documented
* Providing feedback, leading workshops and training sessions
* Confident in calling out potential efficiencies in our tools and processes, making recommendations for process improvements to prevent future occurrences of fraud/financial crime offences
* Managing your own case load to meet performance targets
* Consistently reaching the targets for Productivity and Quality
* Establishing good relationships with various departments throughout the organisation to ensure good operational synergy
* Treating Tide members fairly by taking responsibility to ensure that their needs are met

* Strong stakeholder management skills and comfortable communicating with a wide range of associates
* A proactive and open-minded approach to finding effective solutions
* A genuinely curious mindset, asking the right questions at the right times, with a problem solving attitude
* A keen eye for process improvements, looking at how we can work leaner and more robustly
* Exceptional communication skills – written and verbal – and are able to communicate with our members, internal stakeholders & regulatory bodies if required

* 3 paid days off for volunteering or L&D activities
* Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
* Personal L&D budget
* Additional health & dental insurance
* Mental wellbeing platform
* Food vouchers
* Snacks, light food, drinks in the office

**Description**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Snowflake / Data Engineer with deep expertise in building scalable, reliable, and high-performance data platforms using Snowflake and AWS.The ideal candidate has strong experience designing production-grade data pipelines, developing complex transformations, modeling enterprise data, optimizing Snowflake workloads, and integrating data from systems such as Salesforce, APIs, SaaS platforms, and AWS services.This role will be responsible for building the data foundation that powers analytics, operational workflows, enterprise integrations, reporting, and AI applications.

**What You'll Do**

### **Snowflake Engineering**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions on Snowflake
* Develop databases, schemas, tables, views, secure views, stages, and other Snowflake objects
* Build production-grade SQL and Snowpark-based transformations
* Implement Snowflake Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Snowpipe, and related capabilities
* Design incremental processing and change-data-capture patterns
* Optimize Snowflake queries, warehouses, clustering strategies, and storage patterns
* Monitor and optimize Snowflake compute consumption and platform costs
* Implement secure data-sharing and access patterns

### **Data Pipeline Development**

* Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data
* Develop batch, incremental, near-real-time, and event-driven ingestion pipelines
* Integrate data from Salesforce, REST APIs, SaaS applications, AWS, databases, and file-based sources
* Implement reusable ingestion and transformation frameworks
* Build pipelines capable of handling schema evolution, late-arriving data, retries, and replay
* Develop reconciliation processes to ensure source-to-target completeness and accuracy
* Build orchestration workflows with appropriate dependency and failure management

### **Data Modeling**

* Design scalable analytical and operational data models
* Build dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, data marts, and curated datasets
* Translate complex source-system structures into standardized enterprise data models
* Establish consistent definitions for core business entities and metrics
* Design data layers that support analytics, reporting, operational applications, and AI workloads
* Balance performance, usability, maintainability, and storage efficiency in data-model design

### **Salesforce Data Integration**

* Build reliable pipelines ingesting Salesforce objects and related data into Snowflake

* Handle Salesforce relationships, custom objects, schema changes, and large-volume datasets
* Build incremental and CDC-based synchronization patterns
* Implement reconciliation and data-quality controls between Salesforce and Snowflake

* Build data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, and related technologies

* Build event-driven ingestion and processing workflows

* Implement automated data-quality validation and testing
* Build monitoring for pipeline freshness, completeness, accuracy, and failures
* Implement logging, metrics, alerts, and operational dashboards
* Establish source-to-target reconciliation processes
* Investigate and resolve production data incidents
* Identify upstream and downstream impacts of data changes

* Analyze query profiles and optimize expensive Snowflake workloads
* Optimize warehouse sizing, auto-suspend, auto-resume, and workload isolation
* Improve SQL performance and data-processing efficiency
* Monitor storage and compute consumption
* Identify opportunities to reduce pipeline runtime and infrastructure cost

* Write clean, reusable, testable, and maintainable code
* Participate in architecture and code reviews
* Build automated testing into data pipelines
* Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, and runbooks
* Contribute to CI/CD and automated deployment practices
* Mentor other Data Engineers and help establish engineering standards

* 3+ years of strong hands-on Snowflake experience
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations and query optimization
* Strong Python skills for data processing, automation, and API integrations
* Experience building production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines
* Experience integrating Snowflake with AWS
* Experience ingesting data from Salesforce or similar enterprise SaaS platforms
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling and modern data architecture
* Experience with incremental processing, CDC, and data reconciliation
